message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo was one of the bloodiest engagements of the Napoleonic Wars.  While exact figures vary depending on the source, the generally accepted totals are:

| Side | Approximate casualties (killed, wounded, missing) |
|------|---------------------------------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s army) | ~25 000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22 000 |
| **Combined** | ~47 000 |

These numbers include those killed, wounded, and taken prisoner or otherwise rendered unfit for service.  Some contemporary reports round the combined total to roughly 23 000, but most modern historians cite the higher figure of about 47 000 when all sides are summed.
